categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four business segments: lime manufacturing and sales, carbon dioxide gas business, highway rest area operations, and other businesses including cosmetics retail. The lime segment produces various lime products such as quicklime, hydrated lime, and precipitated calcium carbonate. The carbon dioxide segment manufactures and sells liquid carbon dioxide and dry ice. The rest area segment operates highway rest stops providing food, retail, and convenience services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced processing technologies for high-activity hydrated lime and high-purity lime products, including proprietary separation and refining techniques. It operates multiple manufacturing plants with large-scale production capacity for lime and carbon dioxide products. The carbon dioxide business sources raw gases from petrochemical plants and refines them into high-purity liquid CO2 and dry ice. The company invests in R&D for eco-friendly lime applications, fertilizer granulation, and waste solidification technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include steel manufacturers, construction material companies, environmental pollution control industries, paper and paint manufacturers, and food and beverage companies. The lime products serve steelmaking, water treatment, environmental protection, and agriculture sectors. Carbon dioxide products are supplied to beverage producers, shipbuilding, refrigeration, and industrial users. The rest area business targets highway travelers and tourists. Cosmetics retail targets young consumers with eco-friendly products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in South Korea with manufacturing plants and mines located in various regions including Seoul, Chungbuk, Chungnam, Gangwon, and Ulsan. It serves domestic markets extensively and has begun exporting certain products such as petroleum coke. The company also maintains sales offices in major industrial regions and supplies to nationwide customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It mines raw limestone and processes it into various lime products, supplying directly to end users in steel, construction, and environmental sectors. In the carbon dioxide business, it procures raw gases from upstream petrochemical producers and refines them for industrial and beverage customers. The rest area operations represent a downstream retail service segment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product quality and developing new high-purity lime products to replace imports, expanding eco-friendly and environmental applications, and diversifying raw material sourcing to improve cost competitiveness. R&D efforts focus on advanced lime refining technologies, fertilizer granulation, waste treatment methods, and eco-friendly materials like eco-paper and eco-plastics. The company also pursues partnerships for sustainable raw material supply and market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of lime products, carbon dioxide gases, and dry ice. The rest area segment earns revenue from direct consumer sales of food, retail goods, and services. The cosmetics segment generates revenue from retail sales of branded products. Sales are conducted via direct contracts with industrial customers, distributors, and retail consumers, with payment terms typically involving a mix of cash and promissory notes.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic producer in the lime and carbon dioxide markets, distinguished by multiple production plants and diversified raw material sources compared to competitors who often rely on single suppliers. It holds a strong market position in supplying steel, construction, and environmental sectors. The carbon dioxide business benefits from entry barriers due to raw material supply constraints. The rest area business faces competition from other highway service providers but leverages strategic location and customer service initiatives.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 294 billion KRW with an operating profit of 40 billion KRW, reflecting a 25.5% increase in operating profit despite a 14.7% decrease in revenue compared to the previous year. Total assets stood at about 378 billion KRW with a strong equity ratio of 77.5% and a low debt ratio of 29.1%, indicating solid financial health. The company has shown steady growth in profitability and maintains a mid-sized enterprise status with ongoing investments in production capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-activity lime products that substitute imported materials, offering stable supply and cost advantages to customers. Its multiple raw material sourcing and diversified production facilities ensure supply stability, a key competitive edge. The company also focuses on eco-friendly product development and environmental compliance, aligning with societal trends. In the carbon dioxide segment, it leverages multiple supply sources and long-term contracts to ensure reliability. The rest area business differentiates through location, customer service, and unique product offerings.
